question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James positions itself as a 'destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve,' with Private Client Group President Tash Elwyn stating the firm is committed to serving individuals and families with significant wealth.
items.quote: At Raymond James, we're committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve. Individuals and families with significant wealth require truly personal advice, backed by the right resources, to navigate their financial opportunities and complexities

items.text: Raymond James has built out a private wealth platform including the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched September 2022, providing training, coaching and a peer network for advisors specializing in high-net-worth clients, generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets; nearly 450 advisors had earned the designation as of September 2026.
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets. As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, risk-based model portfolios integrating traditional (equity and fixed income) and alternative investments with a dedicated alternatives allocation, for advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial has introduced Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

items.text: Raymond James's broader high-net-worth effort includes estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, positioned as tools for advisors serving households with complex profiles.
items.quote: That effort includes estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, all positioned as tools that advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles

items.text: Raymond James's private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform are described by CEO Paul Shoukry as supporting advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients

items.text: In response to growing demand for private investment product alternatives for ultra-high-net-worth clients, Raymond James further developed its private capital raising expertise and brought in bespoke private investment alternatives in fiscal 2025.
items.quote: In response to growing demand for private investment product alternatives for ultra-high net worth clients, we further developed the firm's private capital raising expertise and brought in bespoke private investment alternatives for such clients

items.text: Raymond James announced a new leadership structure for its private capital business to help high-net-worth focused advisors better serve their clients with bespoke private investment alternatives.
items.quote: we also announced a new leadership structure for our private capital business to help high-net-worth focus advisors better serve their clients with a wide variety of bespoke private investment alternatives

items.text: Raymond James agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager known for advisor-centric model portfolios and a dedicated high-net-worth service team, which closed in April/May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management.
items.quote: the firm agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management, known for advisor-centric model portfolios and a dedicated high-net-worth service team

items.text: Raymond James provides advisors additional resources to support high-net-worth clients, with an advisor citing its advanced technology and private wealth capabilities as resources for the sophisticated needs of high-net-worth clients within a people-first culture.
items.quote: At Raymond James, advanced technology and private wealth capabilities give us the resources to support the sophisticated needs of high-net-worth clients within a people-first culture

cells.reason: Multiple passages state RJF's strategic initiatives (Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, Private Wealth Advisor designation, private capital/alternatives buildout, Clark Capital acquisition, intergenerational wealth strategies) and leadership statements (Elwyn, Shoukry) evidencing commitment to capturing high-net-worth/wealth-transfer opportunities.
